recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, circular composition featuring two figures in dynamic, falling poses within a fisheye-distorted urban tunnel. The aesthetic uses heavy halftone patterns and a monochromatic sepia-orange palette, anchored by a spiked metallic emblem at the bottom.
coreVisualRelationships: Radial symmetry between the figures and the circular tunnel frame
High-contrast black silhouettes against a glowing orange-yellow core
Text following the outer circular path to reinforce the fisheye distortion
coreInvariants: Halftone dot texture across all photographic elements
Warm monochromatic color scheme (orange, brown, black)

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two figures occupy the central circular space, rotated 180 degrees relative to each other to create a sense of weightlessness.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: A spiked, circular metallic emblem at the 6 o'clock position acts as the primary logo anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the circular text path around the perimeter, then spirals inward toward the central figures.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep black corners outside the circular frame emphasize the 'tunnel' effect.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep burnt orange and sepia tones for the background and highlights.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Solid black for shadows, silhouettes, and the outer frame.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pale yellow-white for the brightest highlights on the figures and emblem.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High contrast with low saturation, relying on value shifts to define form.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are individually rotated to align with the radial path of the circle
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Consistent geometric sans-serif used in two different scales and orientations.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the wide, technical, 90s urban aesthetic
Provides the necessary geometric structure and square terminals

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a circular fisheye view of a textured tunnel in sepia and orange tones. Place two figures in baggy urban clothing in a falling, mirrored pose. Apply a heavy halftone dot filter to the entire image. Add a spiked metallic circular emblem at the bottom center.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place bold, wide geometric sans-serif text in uppercase along the top and side outer edges of the circle, rotating each letter to face the center. Place a stacked version of the same font inside the bottom emblem.

verificationChecks: Is the text following a perfect circular path?
Is the halftone texture visible in the highlights?
Are the figures rotated 180 degrees from each other?
Is the color palette strictly warm tones and black?

adjustableVariables: Number of spikes on the bottom emblem
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the figures
Exact logo text and brand marks
postGenerationChecks: Check for consistent radial alignment of text
Ensure halftone pattern doesn't obscure legibility
Verify the 'tunnel' depth effect is maintained
Confirm the spiked emblem is centered at the bottom
recipe.reuseFormula: Circular Fisheye + Halftone Texture + Radial Geometric Typography + Monochromatic Warm Palette
